result.no_target: Could not talk to the target

refresh_interval.label: Refresh interval (s)
refresh_interval.description: How often openocd is asked for the MCU state. Each poll briefly attaches to the probe.

target_name.label: Target name
target_name.description: openocd target used for curstate, e.g. stm32u5x.cpu

project_dir.label: Project directory
project_dir.description: Directory with the Makefile whose <debug|release>_<staging|production>_bankN targets are built.

chip.label: probe-rs chip
chip.description: Chip name passed to probe-rs download/reset.

bank.label: Flash bank
bank.description: Which bank image to build and flash (0 or 1).

openocd_bin.label: openocd binary
openocd_bin.description: Path or name of the openocd executable.

show_label.label: Show state text
show_label.description: Show Running/Halted next to the icon in the bar.

camera_args.label: Camera arguments
camera_args.description: Options for usbcam.sh, e.g. -r 270 for the mount rotation.

serial_logdir.label: Serial log directory
serial_logdir.description: Where picocom writes its timestamped log files.
